description: A closed-world getattr call has a real target, exercising a documented limit of syntax-based linking.
notes: Known capability limit: resolving invoke to Saver.persist requires propagating the only caller's argument and interpreting getattr.
Ground truth assumes this complete fixture, ordinary Python object behavior, and invocation through run; there is no monkey patching or additional caller.
The module-level Saver construction has no source function as its caller and contributes no function-to-function edge.
